title: University of South Asia Lahore Amendment Act 2021

sections.shortTitle: University of South Asia Lahore Amendment Act 2021
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 729
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 729
ACT XXXI OF 2021
UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH ASIA, LAHORE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the University of South Asia
Lahore Act, 2005
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
1st October, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(76)/2021/2640, dated 1.10.2021.---The University of South Asia, Lahore (Amendment) Bill 2021, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on September 28, 2021, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on October 01, 2021, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the University of South Asia, Lahore Act 2005 (IX of
2005) in the manner hereinafter appearing:
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the University of South Asia, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: University of South Asia Lahore Amendment Act 2021
sections.description:
Amendment in section 4 of Act IX of 2005

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 729
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 729
ACT XXXI OF 2021
UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH ASIA, LAHORE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the University of South Asia
Lahore Act, 2005
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
1st October, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(76)/2021/2640, dated 1.10.2021.---The University of South Asia, Lahore (Amendment) Bill 2021, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on September 28, 2021, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on October 01, 2021, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the University of South Asia, Lahore Act 2005 (IX of
2005) in the manner hereinafter appearing:
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
3. Amendment
in section 4 of Act IX of 2005.---In
the Act, in section 4:
(i) in
clause (a), for sub-clauses (i) and (ii) the following shall be substituted;
"(i)
Faculties of Computer Sciences and Information Techhology, Management Sciences,
Commerce, Law, Humanities and Social Sciences, Art and Fashion Design,
Engineering and Technilogy, Allied Health Sciences, Sciences, and Food and
Culinary Sciences;
(ii)
such other branches of learning as the Board may determine with the approval of
the Chancellor:
Provided
that in case of medical and engineering education, approval of. the Pakistan
Medical Commission and Pakistan Engineering Council respectively shall be a
pre- requisite;"
(ii) for
clause (g), the following shall be substituted;
"(g)
to decide teaching methods and strategies including virtual teaching, on-campus
and, online, distance learning etc. in a such manner as prescribed by the Board
to ensure the most effective education and training programs;"
(iii) after
clause (g) the following clauses (h), (i), (j), (k), (l) and (m) shall be
inserted:
"(h)
to institute programs for the exchange of students and teachers between the
University and other universities, educational institutions and research
organizations, inside as well as outside Pakistan;
(i)
to affiliate and disaffiliate educational institutions under prescribed
conditions as may be determined by the Board;
(j)
to inspect colleges and other educational institutions affiliated or seeking
affiliation with it;
(k)
to accept the examinations passed and the period of study spent by students of
the University at other universities and places of learning equivalent to such
examinations and periods of study in the University, as it may prescribe, and
to withdraw such acceptance on such terms and conditions as may be prescribed
by the Board;
(l)
to appoint members of the various bodies and committees as the Board may
determine for instructional and co-curricular activities and admit students of
the University and its constituent units;
(m)
to regularize any difficulty incurred previously".

PAP/Legis-3(76)/2021/2640, dated 1.10.2021.---The University of South Asia, Lahore (Amendment) Bill 2021, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on September 28, 2021, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on October 01, 2021, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the University of South Asia, Lahore Act 2005 (IX of
2005) in the manner hereinafter appearing:
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
4. Amendment
in section 6 of Act IX of 2005.---In
the Act, in section 6, for subsection (2), the following shall be substituted:
"(2)
The University shall not open any sub-campus or affiliate any other educational
institution for a period of ten years from the commencement of this Act after
which period it may have sub-campuses and or affiliate any other educational
institutions with the approval of the Chancellor."
